instruction: Candid documentary photograph, medium-wide shot, slightly high angle. In an indoor motion capture studio with a red carpet and white walls, the man in the black t-shirt and blue shorts (R1) stands on the left, facing forward and smiling. The woman in the white t-shirt and blue jeans (R2) stands on the right, facing left as she hugs him. She wraps her arm around his neck from the side, while he stands relaxed with his arms down. The room is lit by overhead fluorescent lights, creating a bright and neutral atmosphere.
